test_timedelta_array_non_nano_units: test TimedeltaArray with non-nanosecond units (s, ms, us) including dtype and as_unit validation
test_timedelta_array_field_operations: test TimedeltaArray field operations like days, seconds, microseconds against nanosecond equivalents
test_timedelta_array_total_seconds: test TimedeltaArray total_seconds method for various units and nanosecond precision
test_timedelta_array_arithmetic_operatio: test TimedeltaArray arithmetic including add, mul, div with scalars, arrays, and other TimedeltaArrays
test_timedelta_array_setitem_clears_freq: test that setting an element in a TimedeltaArray clears its freq attribute
test_timedelta_array_unary_ops: test TimedeltaArray unary operations including abs, pos, and neg with NaT values
test_timedelta_array_add_nat_scalars: test TimedeltaArray addition with NaT scalars and Timestamps preserving resolution
test_timedelta_array_searchsorted_invali: test that TimedeltaArray searchsorted raises TypeError for incompatible types
